name: Gary Welch
prior_offices: Chairman, Big Horn County Republican Party
background: The Lovell candidate in the 2022 HD26 four-way Republican primary is the same Louis Gary Welch identified in a May 2021 Wyoming Business Report article as chairman of the Big Horn County Republican Party, when the central committee backed a Second Amendment sanctuary resolution. A civilian occupation and education were not found in that article or in 2022 election-result coverage.
